name: IdleDownloadManager
detailed_description:
IdleDownloadManager is a tool that monitors your chosen folder for downloads and automatically shuts down your PC once downloads finish. Perfect for downloading large files or games. We save energy, we save time. Never worry about babysitting your downloads again.

Features

  • Smart Download Monitoring
    Automatically tracks file activity in your chosen folder and detects when downloads are ongoing.

  • Download completion detection & Auto-Shutdown
    Shuts down, hibernates, or runs a custom command after the download is detected as completed.

  • Customizable Shutdown Options
    Choose between shutdown, sleep, restart, or executing your custom scripts and- or commands.

  • Minimal Resource Usage
    Runs quietly in the background with a clean, minimalist UI.

The perfect tool for gamers, power users, and anyone who downloads large files or games.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4 or better with SSE2 support
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or newer
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4 or better with SSE2 support
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Linux shutdown commands require root privileges.
